title: MPESB MP Nayab Tahsildar Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 73 Posts
intro: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB), Bhopal has released the official notification for the Nayab Tahsildar Departmental Limited Competitive Examination 2026 for 73 vacancies. fullContentHtml:
📢 MPESB Nayab Tahsildar Recruitment 2026 Overview

Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) Bhopal invites online applications for the post of Nayab Tahsildar (Departmental Limited Competitive Examination 2026) under the Revenue Department of Madhya Pradesh. A total of 73 vacancies (Clerical Cadre 46 Posts + Patwari/RI Cadre 27 Posts) will be filled through this examination.

Post / Cadre Name Recruitment Type Total Vacancies
Clerical Service Cadre - Nayab Tahsildar Regular 32
Clerical Service Cadre - Nayab Tahsildar Backlog 14
Patwari / Revenue Inspector Cadre - Nayab Tahsildar Regular 12
Patwari / Revenue Inspector Cadre - Nayab Tahsildar Backlog 15
Total Vacancies 73

🎯 Eligibility Criteria & Age Limit

  • Service Experience: Minimum 5 Years of continuous regular / officiating service as a Clerical Cadre employee, Patwari, or Revenue Inspector (RI) in MP Revenue Department establishments.
  • Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Arts, Science (including Engineering/Technical), Commerce, Agriculture, or equivalent from any recognized University.
  • Age Limit: Maximum age must not exceed 55 Years as on 01 January 2026.
  • Maximum Attempts: Eligible candidates are permitted a maximum of 3 attempts in this departmental examination.
  • Pay Scale: Level-9 (Pay Band ₹36,200 – ₹1,14,800/- plus allowances).

📝 How to Apply for MPESB Nayab Tahsildar 2026

  1. Visit the official portal at esb.mponline.gov.in or esb.mp.gov.in.
  2. Click on the application link for Nayab Tahsildar Limited Competitive Exam 2026.
  3. Ensure Candidate Profile Registration and eKYC (Aadhaar based) are verified.
  4. Log in using Profile ID and Password, and fill in service details, educational qualifications, and preferred exam center.
  5. Upload required documents, signature, and photograph as per prescribed specifications.
  6. Pay the requisite application fee online and take a printout of the confirmation page for record.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q1. What is the last date to apply for MP Nayab Tahsildar 2026?

The last date to submit the online application form is 01 October 2026.

Q2. When will the MPESB Nayab Tahsildar Exam be conducted?

The written examination is scheduled to commence on 14 November 2026.

Q3. What is the salary / pay scale for MP Nayab Tahsildar?

The post carries Pay Scale Level-9 (₹36,200 to ₹1,14,800 per month).

Q4. Who is eligible to apply for this vacancy?

Only serving employees of the MP Revenue Department (Clerk, Patwari, or Revenue Inspector) with at least 5 years of service and a graduate degree are eligible.
